body:
I can confirm this on 4.7.2.stable and 4.8.dev 65e8d1695 (Linux). It's an infinite loop rather than a crash.

Backtrace with gdb:

```
#0  0x00007ffff7867352 in __syscall_cancel_arch () from /lib64/libc.so.6
#1  0x00007ffff785b54c in __internal_syscall_cancel () from /lib64/libc.so.6
#2  0x00007ffff78aac82 in clock_nanosleep@GLIBC_2.2.5 () from /lib64/libc.so.6
#3  0x00007ffff78b6f37 in nanosleep () from /lib64/libc.so.6
#4  0x000055555c2f0963 in OS_Unix::delay_usec (this=0x7fffffffd190, p_usec=10000) at ./drivers/unix/os_unix.cpp:345
#5  0x000055555bf57acb in TilesEditorUtils::~TilesEditorUtils (this=0x55557b4426c0) at modules/tilemap/editor/tiles_editor_plugin.cpp:322
#6  0x00005555608f174e in memdelete<Object> (p_class=0x55557b4426c0) at ./core/os/memory.h:166
#7  0x000055555dbc0ed9 in SceneTree::_flush_delete_queue (this=0x555566cb7fa0) at ./scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:1651
#8  0x000055555dbbba1f in SceneTree::finalize (this=0x555566cb7fa0) at ./scene/main/scene_tree.cpp:869
#9  0x0000555559fc7e18 in OS_LinuxBSD::run (this=0x7fffffffd190) at platform/linuxbsd/os_linuxbsd.cpp:1031
#10 0x00005555608c29c5 in main (argc=2, argv=0x7fffffffd808) at platform/linuxbsd/godot_linuxbsd.cpp:122
```

The line being looped infinitely is here:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e8d16951d6963cb3984c090e45f40d1ba5f704/modules/tilemap/editor/tiles_editor_plugin.cpp#L321-L324

Removing the `.godot/` folder from the MRP resolves the issue, but we should still look into fixing this.

Can reproduce on 4.8.dev 4d10419cacd6d3009976e8f9fd3abd970fd58018 with Windows 11 machine.

The problem points seem to be these:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e8d16951d6963cb3984c090e45f40d1ba5f704/modules/tilemap/editor/tiles_editor_plugin.cpp#L321-L324

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/65e8d16951d6963cb3984c090e45f40d1ba5f704/modules/tilemap/editor/tiles_editor_plugin.cpp#L130-L132

Pattern preview thread waits for frame_pre_draw event.(It is only called from the main thread by RenderingServer.) While main thread is waiting for pattern preview thread to finish. Both threads infinitely wait on each other. This doesn't seem to happen normally. Provided MRP has a lot of errors causing the editor to lag. This might be surfacing underlying issue.

Adding `pattern_preview_done.post();` to the TilesEditorUtils destructor seems to fix the issue. But it feels more like a hack than a proper solution.
